candidates: In `render-components-manifest.ts`, when computing totals for any item category that can appear in multiple structural locations (e.g., attached to a parent manifest entry as well as standalone top-level entries), aggregate counts and error counts from ALL locations before constructing filter pills or badge HTML. Summing only one location produces misleading summary statistics and broken filter-pill counts.

In the manifest debugger (`render-components-manifest.ts`), when introducing a filter pill for a new item type, ensure: (a) the pill is always rendered whenever items of that type exist, independent of error state; and (b) the corresponding CSS `:target` filter selector reveals every instance of that type across the page — both items nested/attached inside existing card types and standalone cards of that type.
